common.offline: You're offline. Some things won't update until you reconnect.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the email address Plan B has on file for you.
auth.codeSubtitle: We sent a {{length}}-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}}s
auth.codeSent: If that email matches our records, we've sent you a code.
auth.codeInvalid: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
auth.codeExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
auth.blocked: Your account has been suspended. Please contact Plan B support.
auth.noAccount: We couldn't sign you in. If you're a Plan B student, contact support to check the email address on your record.
auth.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Plan B on this device?

home.title: Home
home.noProgressBody: Your courses are ready when you are.
home.browseBody: Pick a course to get started. Your progress will show up here.

courses.title: Courses
courses.emptyBody: Plan B will publish your courses here. Check back soon.
courses.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
courses.locked: Finish the previous lesson to unlock this one
courses.noneEnrolledBody: Enrol in a course and it will appear here with your progress.

player.noSkip: You can't skip ahead — watch the lesson to unlock the next one.
player.loadFailed: This lesson couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
player.notReadyBody: Plan B hasn’t uploaded the video for this lesson. It will appear here as soon as they do.
player.offlineBody: Lessons stream from Plan B, so you need to be online to watch. Check your connection and try again.
player.blockedBody: Your account may be suspended, or this course isn’t available to you. Please contact Plan B support.
player.unknownBody: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

paper.title: Assessment
paper.question: Question {{current}} of {{total}}
paper.submitConfirm: Submit your answers? You can't change them afterwards.

blocked.videos_incomplete: Watch every lesson in this course to unlock the assessment.
blocked.attempts_exhausted: You've used all your attempts. Contact Plan B support.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailLocked: Contact Plan B support to change the email on your account.
profile.nameLocked: Contact Plan B support to change your name.
profile.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears on your passport
profile.photoPermission: Plan B needs permission to use your camera or photos to set a profile picture.
profile.photoUnavailable: Photo changes need the latest version of the app. Everything else on this page saves normally.
profile.phoneLocked: To change your phone number we need to text a code to the new one. That is coming soon — contact Plan B support meanwhile.
profile.nameNotice: Use the name exactly as it appears on your passport — Plan B uses it for your visa paperwork.
profile.unsavedBody: You have edits that haven’t been saved.

enrol.paywallBody: One payment. Lifetime access to every lesson and the assessment.
enrol.failed: We couldn't start your enrolment. Please try again.

payment.title: Checkout
payment.methodQuestion: How would you like to pay?
payment.cardBody: You'll finish paying on our payment partner's secure page. Plan B never sees your card details.
payment.cardOpenFailed: We couldn't open the payment page. Please try again.
payment.cardUnavailable: Card payment needs the latest version of the app. Please update, or pay by bank transfer.
payment.confirmingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. Please don't close the app.
payment.notConfirmedBody: We haven't had confirmation from your bank yet. If the money has left your account your access will open shortly — you can check back under Payments.
payment.bankBody: Transfer the exact amount to the account below, then send us the slip. Plan B confirms transfers within one working day.
payment.bankUnavailable: Bank transfer isn't available right now. Please pay by card.
payment.referenceHint: The reference your bank gave you for this transfer.
payment.referenceRequired: Enter the reference number from your bank.
payment.slipHint: A clear photo of your deposit slip or transfer confirmation.
payment.slipRequired: Attach a photo of your transfer slip.
payment.slipPermission: Plan B needs permission to use your camera or photos to attach your transfer slip.
payment.slipUnavailable: Attaching a photo needs the latest version of the app. Please update, or pay by card.
payment.submitted: Sent. Plan B will confirm your payment shortly.
payment.submitFailed: We couldn't send your slip. Please try again.
payment.awaitingBody: Plan B has your slip and will confirm it within one working day. Your course unlocks as soon as it's approved.
payment.rejectedTitle: Your last transfer was not accepted
payment.historyEmptyBody: When you enrol in a paid course, your orders appear here.
payment.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
